sections.body:
##   CodeAnt Nitpicks
2 code suggestions #### 1. A cancellation or rejection between this check and the unconditional repository update is overwritten by `Confirmed`, so concurrent requests can still re-approve terminal bookings. Race condition · [`app/Services/BookingSettingsService.php:1136`](https://github.com/Bizionic-Tech/earnon/pull/115/files#diff-cde69094ae801f020d46a0effea9e61020972bb24bb7c39f985b4278d442572cR1136-R1136) --- #### 2. When `booking_settings_id` is an array, `find()` returns a collection and this method call throws before the integer rule can reject the request. Type error · [`app/Http/Requests/StoreBookingRequest.php:19`](https://github.com/Bizionic-Tech/earnon/pull/115/files#diff-22eddd851f64e1e7445c6f184c2a40f340298908e9f757993506403625630accR19-R19)
---
2 custom suggestions #### 1. Consolidate this lookup with the booking-settings existence check and subsequent service lookup so the same setting is not fetched repeatedly during one request. Custom_rule · [`app/Http/Requests/StoreBookingRequest.php:16`](https://github.com/Bizionic-Tech/earnon/pull/115/files#diff-22eddd851f64e1e7445c6f184c2a40f340298908e9f757993506403625630accR16-R16) --- #### 2. Reuse the booking setting loaded for this check in the later service logic instead of querying the same setting again. Custom_rule · [`app/Services/BookingSettingsService.php:1410`](https://github.com/Bizionic-Tech/earnon/pull/115/files#diff-cde69094ae801f020d46a0effea9e61020972bb24bb7c39f985b4278d442572cR1410-R1410)

sections.title: CodeAnt PR Risk
sections.body: ##   CodeAnt PR Risk **🟡  Medium Risk** - The PR needs attention before merging because the meetup settings lookup can return choices for inactive services or availability that booking submission rejects. - The proposal-response endpoint may silently decline when the decision is missing or invalid; validate the decision before changing proposal state. - Meetup entries in the creator service listing may lack delivery-mode fields clients use to select the booking flow. **Assessed commit:** `fc1adb179a06`
